purpose: Minimal backend-neutral contract for two-plane Project Knowledge / Scientific Knowledge over a shared Evidence/Provenance Spine.

field_map_import_contract.role: candidate input from external field scouting; never automatic truth
field_map_import_contract.promotion_guard: FRONTIER_CANDIDATE != NOVEL; field-map ingestion creates candidate records only until source-linked qualification events exist.
field_map_import_contract.immutable_candidate_marker: Every imported field-map object/frontier carries qualification_state=CANDIDATE until a separate qualification event changes its epistemic status.
field_map_import_contract.stale_frontier_guard: An explicit/open problem is not imported as an active frontier without an external anchor plus last_verified_active and framework_activity_state.
field_map_import_contract.abandoned_framework_guard: An open question internal to an inactive/abandoned framework must be labeled accordingly and is not promoted to field-level frontier by openness alone.

invariants: STORAGE != NOTICE != DELIVERY != RECEIPT != ACCEPTANCE != SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION
extension_rule: Unknown domain-specific relation/event types may be namespaced rather than forcing a universal ontology change.
kill_or_simplify_if: structured substrate is not materially better than ordinary search/RAG on load-bearing tasks
representation suppresses dissent or creates false closure
knowledge capture becomes a mandatory router or Moderator burden
schema distorts one scientific phenotype to fit another

after a bounded number of real contributions, the share of S-plane records supported only by internal synthesis does not materially decrease; trigger external-contact/source-spine review before scaling

source_anchor_contract.rule: A whole-document synthesis pointer may preserve lineage, but load-bearing records must additionally point to a SOURCE_ANCHOR sufficient to localize the supporting statement.

evidence_contract.formal_math_guard: A formal_mathematics CLAIM may receive epistemic_status SUPPORTED_CURRENT only if provenance includes an EVIDENCE object of evidence_type PROOF (or an explicitly equivalent proof artifact) with a source anchor.

closure_guards.rule: CLOSED_IN_SCOPE or EXACT_PRIOR_ART_ABSORPTION based on external prior art requires a located source and load-bearing source anchor. Otherwise use a pending-source-verification state/relation.
Project adoption/closure/authority events cannot automatically create or upgrade S-plane epistemic state; S-plane support cannot automatically enact P-plane adoption/authority.

bounded_retrieval_safety.asymmetric_truncation_rule: A bounded packet may omit support before it omits active scientific boundaries.

warrant_boundary_contract.meaning: Current limit on what the project is warranted to claim; not itself a permanent negative fact about the world.

issuer_contract.issuer_cell_id: mandatory for state events; identifies accountable participant/cell
issuer_contract.artifact_or_document: belongs in provenance_refs, never substitutes for issuer_cell_id

sp_audit_patch_register.implementation_variation: Adversarial P/S leakage cases live in a dedicated conformance-fixtures file, not in the scientific seed, to avoid polluting live scientific knowledge with synthetic test objects.
